# GitHub Copilot instructions

This is a university full-stack web application project.

Project topic:
Habit Tracker / Szokáskövető alkalmazás

Use the following stack:
- Frontend: React + Vite + TypeScript
- Backend: Node.js + Express + TypeScript
- Database: SQLite
- ORM: Prisma
- Authentication: express-session and bcrypt

General rules:
- Use TypeScript everywhere.
- Keep the code simple and readable.
- Do not create unnecessary complex architecture.
- Use REST API endpoints.
- Use session-based authentication.
- Never store plain text passwords.
- Use bcrypt for password hashing.
- Use Prisma for database access.
- Separate routes, controllers, services and middlewares.
- Users can only access their own habits.
- Admin users can manage users and default categories.
- Add basic validation.
- Add clear error handling.
- Avoid overengineering.
- Prefer beginner-friendly code.
